data.content: ["Surfside Beach offers a relaxed coastal escape with excellent local food options and outdoor beach activities, perfectly matching your group's desire for laid-back days without the early mornings or nightlife scene.", "Finger Lakes provides scenic outdoor beauty and renowned food culture with charming restaurants ideal for leisurely meals, while maintaining the calm, unhurried atmosphere your group prioritizes.", "Matagorda delivers a peaceful beach retreat with strong outdoor activities and casual dining experiences, avoiding the crowded nightlife scene Alice wants to skip while keeping the pace relaxed.", "Clearwater Beach combines beautiful outdoor recreation with solid food and dining options in a more developed area, offering enough urban amenities for exploration without the high-energy nightclub atmosphere your group wants to avoid.", "Carolina Beach provides a balanced beach vacation with good dining opportunities and outdoor activities in a laid-back setting, respecting the no-club constraint and preference for unrushed mornings throughout your stay."]
